# `Q-21-3` — Typst Compile Failed

> The `typst compile` subprocess exited with a nonzero status. Its
> stderr is reproduced verbatim below, including typst's own diagnostic
> (file/line, if any).

## What this means

Pandoc successfully wrote a `.typ` file, but the subsequent `typst
compile` step failed to turn it into a PDF.

## Why this happens

- A construct in the document produces Typst source typst's compiler
  rejects (a malformed raw Typst block, an unsupported property value).
- A referenced image file is missing or not decodable by typst.
- A referenced Typst package (beyond the ones Quarto vendors) could not
  be resolved.

## How to fix

Read typst's own error message, reproduced verbatim in the diagnostic —
it names the offending file and line inside the intermediate `.typ`
source. Setting `keep-typ: true` retains that intermediate file so it
can be inspected directly.

## Related errors

- [`Q-21-1`](Q-21-1.qmd) — typst could not be found at all.
- [`Q-21-2`](Q-21-2.qmd) — typst was found, but its version is too old.
